title: 第九章 缺钱第十章 交易意外
content_zh:
楚元很快就定下了短期的规划；
转化身法，购买兵器，这是最紧要的事情。
再之后，系统每天一次的转化额度还要用在转化丹药上面；
今天就没有转化丹药，修行速度便一下子降了下来。
在学校的聚能阵中修行了一天，可效果还没有服用一枚聚气散来的好
“这两瓶丹药能卖多少钱？”
珍珑阁柜台的小姑娘有些有些诧异的看了一眼楚元，这个男生还穿着一中的校服，既然能拿出这些武道丹药，应该是高三的学生才对？
那他应该留着这些武道丹药自己修炼，为什么要把它们卖出去？
难道是骗家里钱的那种
这个念头一闪即逝，她也没有多管闲事的想法；
只是拿出一个仪器简单的检查了一下。
“壮骨丹和凝神丹，药效保存完整；
壮骨丹一粒一万，凝神丹一万五总共是二十五万，客人要出售么？”
这种武道基础丹药的价格基本上都是固定死的，除非量特别大，否则一般没有什么讲价的空间。
楚元想了一下，又问道“你们这里有没有武者用的兵器出售？”
“当然是有的，不知道客人需要什么兵器？”女生笑道，珍珑阁作为大秦最大的武道商会，基本上武道所涉及的所有业务都有；
“剑。”
女生拿出平板，划了几下之后递给楚元；
“这是我们晨阳市分部现在有存货的武道宝剑，客人可以挑选一下；
如果有更高的需求，也可以申请总部调派。”

其实正常来说，晨阳珍珑阁的库存就已经足够满足普通武者的需求，毕竟只是一个后方的小城市；
而更珍贵的神兵利器晨阳市的武者大概率是买不起，也用不上的。
楚元接过来，随便看了两眼，暗自有些心惊；
这上面最便宜的一把剑，价格也在一百万！
而比较贵一点的，上千万都有！
仅凭自己卖的那些丹药肯定是不够的
要知道，一个普通人，一个月的平均工资才有五六千左右涉及到武道的东西，溢价居然这么严重么！？
不过也不能全部都算溢价，毕竟真正的武者兵器所用的材料也十分珍贵，大多都是秘境的产出，或者是异族身上的材料；
寻常异族身上的材料还不行
那些一阶、二阶的异族，身上的骨骼鳞甲甚至还没有精钢结实，当然是不能用来铸造兵器的。
普通人的确可能工作一辈子也买不起一把武者兵器，可普通人一辈子也无法杀死一只高阶异族！
想通了这点之后，楚元神色又平静下来，把平板递给女生
“谢谢。”
女生见状也猜到楚元买不起，并不追问，只是礼貌微笑道“不客气，那客人的丹药还卖么？”
“不卖了。”
“您慢走。”
计划破产，自己那点武道基础丹药实在不值钱
楚元暗自想着，要不然就先把兵器的事情放一放？
反正现在好像也没什么用得着的地方，继续用精钢长剑也不是不能练。
content_en:
Chu Yuan quickly made a short-term plan;
Transforming body skills and purchasing weapons are the most important things.
After that, the system’s daily conversion quota will also be used to convert elixirs;
There was no transformation elixir today, so the speed of practice suddenly dropped.
I practiced for a day in the school's energy-gathering array, but the effect was not as good as taking a gas-gathering powder.
"How much can these two bottles of elixir be sold for?"
The little girl at the counter of Zhenlong Pavilion glanced at Chu Yuan in surprise. This boy was still wearing the uniform of No. 1 Middle School. Since he could take out these martial arts pills, he must be a senior in high school?
Then he should keep these martial arts elixirs for his own cultivation, why should he sell them?
Is it the kind of person who defrauds family money?
The thought was fleeting, and she had no intention of meddling in her own business;
I just took out an instrument and checked it briefly.
“The bone-strengthening pill and the spirit-concentrating pill have completely preserved their medicinal effects;
The bone-strengthening pill costs 10,000 per pill and the mind-concentrating pill costs 15,000. The total is 250,000. Does the customer want to sell it? "
The price of this kind of basic martial arts elixir is basically fixed. Unless the quantity is particularly large, there is generally no room for bargaining.
Chu Yuan thought for a moment and then asked, "Do you have any weapons for warriors for sale here?"
"Of course there are. I wonder what weapons the guests need?" the girl said with a smile. As the largest martial arts chamber of commerce in the Qin Dynasty, Zhenlong Pavilion has basically all the businesses involved in martial arts;
"Sword."
The girl took out the tablet, scratched it a few times and handed it to Chu Yuan;
"This is the martial arts sword that our Chenyang City branch currently has in stock. Customers can choose from it;
If there are higher needs, you can also apply for transfer from the headquarters. "
In fact, normally speaking, the inventory of Chenyang Zhenlong Pavilion is enough to meet the needs of ordinary warriors. After all, it is just a small city in the rear;
As for the more precious magical weapons, warriors in Chenyang City will most likely not be able to afford them or use them.
Chu Yuan took it and glanced at it casually, feeling a little scared secretly;
The cheapest sword here costs one million!
The more expensive ones cost tens of millions!
The pills you sell alone are definitely not enough.
You know, the average salary of an ordinary person is only about five or six thousand a month. For things related to martial arts, is the premium so serious? ?
However, not all of them can be considered a premium. After all, the materials used in real warrior weapons are also very precious, and most of them are produced in secret realms or materials from foreign races;
The materials from ordinary alien races are not good enough
The skeletons and scales of those first- and second-level aliens are not even as strong as fine steel, so of course they cannot be used to forge weapons.
It is true that ordinary people may not be able to afford a warrior weapon even after working for a lifetime, but ordinary people cannot kill a high-level alien in a lifetime!
After thinking about this, Chu Yuan calmed down again and handed the tablet to the girl.
"Thank you."
When the girl saw this, she also guessed that Chu Yuan couldn't afford it, so she didn't ask any further questions. She just smiled politely and said, "You're welcome. Do you still sell the guest's elixir?"
"Not for sale."
"You walk slowly."
The plan is to go bankrupt. The few basic martial arts elixirs I have are really worthless.
Chu Yuan thought to himself, how about letting the weapons matter go?
Anyway, it seems that there is nothing useful now, so it is not impossible to continue to practice with the stainless steel sword.
